name: Integrate evidence into an argument
short_description: Integrate evidence into an argument once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can integrate evidence into an argument in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Integrate evidence into an argument means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Integrate evidence into an argument in a fresh real-life scenario.
